# German Learning School

> German Learning School is an online German language school based in Pakistan, focused on making German easy to learn for Pakistani beginners through structured, live-taught Zoom classes. It offers a complete German language course track from absolute beginner (A1) through upper-intermediate (B2), built specifically for Pakistani students preparing for visas, university admission, skilled-worker migration, or the Goethe-Institut and telc exams. The school teaches all four core skills (reading, writing, listening, speaking) with weekly live classes, structured practice materials, and dedicated exam-preparation tracks, rather than a self-study app.

## Who this is for
- Pakistani students who want to learn German online in Pakistan from zero, with live teacher-led classes rather than self-study apps.
- Students preparing for a Germany student visa, work visa, or Ausbildung (vocational training) who need a specific CEFR level (A1-B2) certified.
- Healthcare professionals (doctors and nurses) preparing for the telc B2 Medizin / Pflege exam required for German medical license recognition.
- Anyone comparing German language schools in Pakistan and looking for a structured, exam-focused course rather than informal tutoring.

## Courses
- [German A1 Course](https://germanlearningschool.com/courses/german-a1): The easiest starting point to learn German in Pakistan from complete beginner level, live classes, batch schedule, and fees.
- [German A2 Course](https://germanlearningschool.com/courses/german-a2): Elementary-level German course, live classes and exam preparation.
- [German B1 Course](https://germanlearningschool.com/courses/german-b1): Intermediate-level German course for visa and university language requirements.
- [German B2 Course](https://germanlearningschool.com/courses/german-b2): Upper-intermediate German course, commonly required for work and study visas.
- [All Courses & Fees](https://germanlearningschool.com/courses): Full list of current German language course batches, schedules, and pricing in Pakistan.
- [Goethe Exam Preparation](https://germanlearningschool.com/goethe-exam-preparation): Dedicated preparation track for the Goethe-Institut German exams.

## Learning Resources
- [Free Resources](https://germanlearningschool.com/resources): Free German vocabulary lists and grammar (case) reference tables — a good starting point for anyone trying to learn German online for free before committing to a course.
- [Practice Tests](https://germanlearningschool.com/practice-tests): Interactive German practice tests by level (A1-B2) covering reading, vocabulary, grammar, and speaking.
- [German Translator Tool](https://germanlearningschool.com/translator): Free online German translation tool.
- [Blog](https://germanlearningschool.com/blog): Articles comparing German exams (Goethe vs telc), visa document requirements, and realistic timelines for learning German as a Pakistani student.
- [FAQ](https://germanlearningschool.com/faq): Frequently asked questions about learning German in Pakistan, course structure, and enrollment.
